statementModal.title: Accessibility Statement
statementModal.intro: We are dedicated to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities and continually improving the user experience for everyone.
statementModal.standardText: This website strives to conform to the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Law, Israeli Standard IS 5568 Level AA, and the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.1 AAA / ADA Title III).
statementModal.featuresText: The website incorporates an accessibility toolset supporting keyboard navigation, visible focus indicators, font and spacing scaling, advanced contrast filters, screen-reader landmarks, and motion reduction.
statementModal.physicalDefault: Our physical premises provide accessible entrances, elevator access, wheelchair ramps, and nearby accessible parking.
statementModal.coordinatorDesc: For any inquiries, requests, or accessibility accommodations, please contact our Accessibility Coordinator:
statementModal.reportDesc: Despite our best efforts to make all content accessible, you may encounter temporary limitations. Please report any issues directly to our accessibility officer.
